summary: reference-impl tests pass (698/698). Standard suite fails: L3 Host conformance test 'every agent contract dereferences as valid OpenAPI 3.1' times out at 5000ms on CLV-81 but passes on main in ~2.6s. Verified by running the same test against both main and the CLV-81 SHA in identical prep-worktree environments. The agent contracts (implementer/qa/reviewer) $ref task.schema.json; expanding it with the new scope.files_touched object pushes SwaggerParser dereferencing past the 5s timeout. findings.message: L3 Host conformance > every agent contract dereferences as valid OpenAPI 3.1 — Test timed out in 5000ms on cloverleaf/CLV-81 (SHA 1a0f9be). Confirmed CAUSED by CLV-81 changes: same test passes on main (269e323) in ~2.6s under identical prep-worktree environment. The implementer/qa/reviewer agent contracts $ref task.schema.json; expanding it with the new scope.files_touched object increases SwaggerParser validation time. Fix options: (1) bump the test's timeout to 10000ms by passing it as the third argument to the it() call (least invasive — does not change the schema's public surface), or (2) restructure the scope schema to be flatter / lighter (e.g., move files_touched to a top-level optional property without the wrapping scope object).
